title: SimCT: Recovering Lost Supervision for Cross-Tokenizer On-Policy Distillation
abstract: arXiv:2605.07711v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: On-policy distillation (OPD) is a standard tool for transferring teacher behavior to a smaller student, but it implicitly assumes that teacher and student predictions are comparable token by token, an assumption that fails whenever the two models tokenize the same text differently. Under heterogeneous tokenizers, exact shared-token matching silently discards a large fraction of the teacher signal at precisely the positions where vocabularies disagree. We propose \textbf{\underline{Sim}ple \underline{C}ross-\underline{T}okenizer OPD (SimCT)}, which restores this signal by enlarging the supervision space: alongside shared tokens, SimCT compares teacher and student over short multi-token continuations that both tokenizers can realize, leaving the OPD loss form itself unchanged. We show that these units are the finest jointly tokenizable supervision interface, and that coarser alternatives remove teacher-student distinctions that are use

translated_title: SimCT：为跨分词器在线策略蒸馏恢复丢失的监督信号
translated_abstract: 在线策略蒸馏（OPD）是将教师模型行为迁移到更小的学生模型的标准工具，但它隐含地假设教师和学生的预测可以逐个token进行比较，这一假设在两个模型对同一文本采用不同分词方式时会失效。在异构分词器的情况下，精确的共享token匹配会在词表不一致的位置默默地丢弃大部分教师信号。我们提出了SimCT（简单跨分词器在线策略蒸馏），通过扩大监督空间来恢复这一信号：除了共享token之外，SimCT还在两个分词器都能实现的短多token延续序列上比较教师和学生，同时保持OPD损失函数形式本身不变。我们证明这些单元是最细粒度的可联合分词监督接口，而更粗粒度的替代方案会消除有价值的教师-学生区分（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: SimCT通过在共享token匹配之外引入两个分词器均可实现的短多token延续作为监督单元，在不改变OPD损失形式的前提下，恢复了跨分词器在线策略蒸馏中因词表不一致而丢失的教师信号。
en_tdlr: SimCT recovers teacher signal lost in cross-tokenizer on-policy distillation by augmenting shared-token matching with short multi-token continuations realizable by both tokenizers, without changing the OPD loss form.
